## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly grounded by the cited theorem, including the integral coefficient ring and parameter formulas.
- claim-2: Mathematically correct. The interval is bijective with \(\rho\subseteq b^a\): since \(b\le i\), every intermediate partition is uniquely \((i^j,\rho)\). Splitting according to \(\rho_1<b\) or \(\rho_1=b\) gives the stated recurrence and Gaussian binomial. No accepted objective explicitly covers this graded enumerator.
- claim-3: Correct. When \(a=0\), the indexing rectangle is empty and only \(\mu=i^j\) occurs.
- The requested target—an exact graded cardinality formula for the specified source-minimal family—was established. It does not establish invariance of this distribution across all minimal generating families.

## Required revisions
- Rename the generating-function variable \(q\), since project notation also uses \(q=n-r\); for example, use \(z\).
- Explicitly state the interval-to-rectangle bijection and the convention defining the Gaussian binomial polynomial.
